text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 'Arima Kinen,' where first-rate Umamusume gather.
Nakayama Racecourse was enveloped in an extraordinary fervor.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, we've arrived at the final leg
of Fuji Kiseki-san's 4-race challenge, and the stands
are bursting with unprecedented excitement—!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki can do it!
I truly believe in her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: "Me too! I came here today to see a miracle!"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
—Please leave a message
for the Umamusume you're rooting for!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Member A
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone! Let's send even a little bit
of our power to Lady Fuji! Ready, and—!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki Fan Club Members
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fujiiii~~!
Do your beeest~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As everyone eagerly awaits the race—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, what a loud voice.
Thank you, I can hear you loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Fuji Kiseki composed herself,
looking straight over at me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
we've finally made it this far, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The final chapter, the grand stage of the 2,500m Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This is my endgame.
Will it be a happy ending, or a bad ending—?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Am I shining bright, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...How does it look through your eyes?
choice_data_list: You are the absolute finest Étoile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'm glad you're here with me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the words "Do your best, Fuji Kiseki" in my
heart, I sent her off toward the grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, the curtain rises on the Arima Kinen—!
